nodes.summary: Bash maintenance script that loads .env, then uses the Google Translate API to backfill Arabic translations for addon slots, optional fields, discounts, and order tables in the database.
nodes.languageNotes: Exports variables from .env via grep/xargs and requires DATABASE_URL and GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_API_KEY.

nodes.name: translate_text
nodes.summary: Calls the Google Translate API to translate a source string into Arabic and returns the translated text.

nodes.name: get.html
nodes.summary: Standalone marketing/download HTML page with favicon declarations, preloaded EN/AR logotypes, and an inline light-default theme bootstrap script that applies the resolved theme before paint.
